name: Maxwell Engineering Solutions
summary: Maxwell Engineering Solutions makes and refurbishes precision parts for underwater pelletizing systems, such as die plates, blades and cutter hubs, at a Vadodara plant that started in July 2025, and earns most of its sales from exports. Total income grew from ₹10.9 cr in FY24 to ₹30.8 cr in FY26, and profit rose 29% in FY26 to ₹11.9 cr. Borrowings grew faster than income, from ₹3.2 cr to ₹16.7 cr, and the company was only incorporated in September 2022. The whole ₹57.6 cr issue is fresh money; about 42% is for new machinery and buildings, and the post-issue P/E of about 18.3x is well below the two profitable listed peers in the offer document.

fh1.finding: Total income rose from ₹10.87 cr (FY24) to ₹30.76 cr (FY26), a CAGR of about 68%.

fh2.finding: Total income grew every year: ₹10.87 cr, ₹22.59 cr, ₹30.76 cr (FY24–FY26).

fh3.finding: Debt to equity was 0.56 at July 31, 2026 (borrowings ₹15.77 cr vs net worth ₹27.92 cr).

fh4.finding: Borrowings rose about 424% (₹3.19 cr to ₹16.73 cr) while total income rose about 183% over FY24–FY26.

fh5.finding: Net worth rose every year: ₹3.33 cr, ₹13.01 cr, ₹24.87 cr (FY24–FY26).

fh6.finding: Operating cash flow was ₹7.48 cr in FY26, about 63% of the ₹11.86 cr profit.

pr1.finding: Profit after tax grew 29% in FY26, to ₹11.86 cr.

pr2.finding: Net margin on total income rose from 29.1% (FY24) to 40.6% (FY25), then eased to 38.6% (FY26).

pr3.finding: Return on net worth was 47.7% in FY26 (ROE 62.6%), helped by the small equity base.

pr5.finding: Peer margins were not found in public sources.

va1.finding: Post-issue P/E of about 18.3x (₹216.4 cr market cap vs FY26 profit of ₹11.86 cr) vs a peer median of 99.8x (Omnitech 99.0x, Sunita Tools 100.7x; Kabra loss-making).

va2.finding: Post-issue price to book of about 2.6x (₹216.4 cr market cap vs about ₹82.5 cr post-issue net worth) vs a peer median of 9.5x.

va3.finding: Peer market cap to sales figures were not found in public sources.

va4.finding: No details of pre-IPO share issues or transfers were found in public sources.

pg1.finding: Promoters hold 71.36% after the issue, down from 97.26%.

pg2.finding: No information on pledged promoter shares was found.

pg3.finding: Related-party transaction figures were not found in public sources.

pg4.finding: No information on regulatory action against promoters was found.

is1.finding: The entire ₹57.64 cr issue is fresh; there is no offer for sale.

is2.finding: The issue is about 26.6% of the ₹216.4 cr post-issue market cap.

is3.finding: No selling shareholders, because there is no offer for sale.

up1.finding: ₹24.5 cr, or about 42.5% of the issue, goes to new machinery, lab equipment and a new office and plant building.

up2.finding: ₹4.30 cr, or about 7.5% of the issue, goes to repaying borrowings.

up3.finding: The general corporate purposes amount is not stated in public sources.

up4.finding: Public sources don't say whose loans are being repaid.

lg1.finding: Litigation amounts were not found in public sources.

lg2.finding: An ESIC notice for alleged statutory non-compliance is disclosed; other legal proceedings are mentioned without details.

lg3.finding: Contingent liabilities were not found in public sources.

rk1.finding: Dependence on a few customers for most revenue is called out as a risk; exact shares are not published.

rk2.finding: The largest supplier was 24.98% of purchases in April–July 2026 and 17.28% in FY26, though top 10 suppliers were 80–87%.

rk3.finding: Incorporated in September 2022, so about 4 years of operating history.

rk4.finding: Auditor remarks were not found in public sources.
